title: Infrastructure Specialist, System Administration
description:
Anovia (formerly Innovatia Technical Services) is an industry-leading technology outsourcing support provider with expertise in the telecommunications industry. Operating for over 20 years, we specialize in workflow and knowledge processes, as well as technical support, helpdesk and multilingual support services. With over 200 professional experts across the globe, we service some of the world's most successful Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 companies.
  
  
The Infrastructure Specialist, System Administration will be responsible for providing advanced technical support and leading enterprise server infrastructure operations in a large global client environment. The role requires strong hands-on experience in Linux, Windows Server, or IBM AIX administration, along with expertise in server migrations, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, high availability, clustering, automation, and disaster recovery. The candidate will act as an L3 escalation point, lead complex incident resolution, drive root-cause analysis, and mentor junior administrators.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as the L3 escalation point and technical lead for Linux, Windows or AIX server environments.
* Lead server migrations, OS upgrades and data centre or cloud transitions, including assessment, planning, execution and validation.
* Design and implement high availability and clustering solutions, such as Pacemaker, Windows Failover Clustering or PowerHA.
* Own major incidents end to end, lead root-cause analysis and drive permanent fixes.
* Define and enforce standards for patching, hardening, monitoring and backup across the estate.
* Build automation frameworks with Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell or Python to reduce manual effort.
* Review and approve technical changes, and represent the team in change advisory meetings.
* Mentor L1/L2 administrators and review their work.
* Communicate clearly with client stakeholders on incidents, risks and service improvement plans.
* Maintain architecture documentation, runbooks and knowledge base articles.

**Skills Required**

* 6+ years of hands-on administration of Linux (RHEL), Windows Server or IBM AIX in large production environments.
* Proven experience leading OS migrations, upgrades or virtualization and cloud transitions.
* Strong expertise in VMware vSphere and/or Azure or AWS infrastructure.
* Expertise in high availability, clustering and disaster recovery.
* Advanced scripting and automation using Ansible plus Shell, PowerShell or Python.
* Strong knowledge of storage (SAN/NAS, LVM), networking fundamentals, DNS, Active Directory or LDAP, and security hardening.
* Strong ITIL practices and experience owning major incidents and root-cause analysis.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills for client-facing work.

**Qualifications**

* 8 to 12 years of total experience, with at least 6 years of relevant system administration experience.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or an equivalent discipline.
* Preferred certifications: RHCSA or RHCE, Microsoft Certified (Windows Server or Azure Administrator), VMware VCP, AWS SysOps Administrator, and ITIL Foundation.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise production environments.
* Willingness to support rotational shifts, on-call escalation and weekend change windows when required.
* Ability to work from the client office from day one.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical and communication skills.

**Good to have**

* Terraform and infrastructure-as-code pipelines.
* Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift administration.
* Middleware administration (WebSphere, WebLogic, JBoss).
* IBM Power Systems: PowerVM, VIOS, NIM and LPAR management.
* Workload automation tools such as Control-M.

**Benefits At Anovia**

* Comprehensive Health Insurance policy
* Employee Wellness Program with focus on mental health
* Robust reward and recognition programs
* Company incentive programs offered.
* Attractive leave policy: Holiday Leave, Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Birthday leave, Bereavement Leave and Paid Leave for personal time off
* Ample growth and learning opportunities.
* Remote work opportunities
* Focus on work/life balance.
* Immigration Program supporting immigration to Canada for eligible employees.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
  
  
Anovia is an equal opportunity employer.

description:

Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We are advancing the world’s energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure, and we collaborate with customers and partners to enable a sustainable energy future – for today’s generations and those to come.
  
  
At Hitachi Energy, whether you are a pioneer confronting the market, an engineer driving technological innovation, or an enabler enhancing organizational effectiveness – this is where your unique value converges. Your professional expertise will transcend conventional boundaries, making extraordinary contributions to our collective evolution.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* You will work under OSI’s case ownership and direction while applying independent, objective and professionally qualified investigative expertise.
* You will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of investigating integrity concerns and/or support OSI in any step in their investigations. This includes the intake process, data collection & analysis, interview and reporting phase.
* You will act as the subject matter expert for finance and forensic accounting. Reconstruct transactions, follow funds, quantify potential loss or exposure, identify control circumvention, and assess indicators of fraud, bribery, corruption, conflicts of interest, and other integrity concerns (‘License to Operate’ concerns).
* You will use data analytics and technology with your knowledge of and experience. Key systems include SAP S/4HANA and related platforms such as Ariba, Concur and other business systems. Use Power BI, Tableau or comparable tools, and use E-Discovery tools (Reveal, Relativity).
* You will coordinate and communicate with stakeholders such as Finance, Legal, HR, Compliance, IT, Security and external experts as appropriate.
* You will support OSI in identifying gaps in the control environment and proposing corrective actions. Analyze individual and aggregated cases to identify recurring schemes, root causes, control weaknesses and opportunities to strengthen policies, procedures and preventive controls.
* You will perform self-service analytics and targeted detection activities based on prior cases, including analyses of expenses, procurement, third parties and other risk areas when investigation demand permits. Develop reusable tests, indicators, and investigative methods that improve early detection and investigation efficiency.
* You will support Internal Audit assignments as agreed when no OSI investigations are ongoing, while remaining fully available for reassignment to investigations at short notice.
* You will maintain high-quality investigation files, contribute to consistent methodologies and templates, share lessons learned, coach colleagues, and continuously develop expertise in investigations, forensic accounting, analytics and relevant legal and professional requirements.
* You will provide timely updates to the Forensic Audit Manager, OSI investigator and other authorized stakeholders. Communicate significant developments, evidence gaps, delays and constraints, and promptly escalate urgent legal, regulatory, financial, safety or reputational matters through the agreed channels.
* You will follow solid-line reporting to the Head of Internal Audit and functional reporting to the Head of OSI.
* You will implement joint governance between Internal Audit and OSI for target setting, performance management, case allocation, availability and capacity management, and competence and career development.
* You will recognize that OSI owns and leads investigations; the forensic audit team performs investigative work under the agreed mandate and case governance.
* You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* You combine sound investigative judgment, strong finance knowledge and analytical curiosity with the ability to communicate sensitive matters clearly and professionally.
* Master's degree, preferably in economics, finance, accounting, business administration, or equivalent discipline.
* Three to five years of demonstrated experience in audit, finance, forensic accounting, data analytics, compliance or investigations, including hands-on support of investigations or forensic reviews.
* Strong knowledge of/ and experience related to investigation policies, methodologies and professional practices, including planning, evidence handling, interviewing, documentation, reporting, confidentiality and case closure.
* Professional certification preferred, such as CFE, CFCS, CCEP, CAMS, CISA or CIA.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, sensitive stakeholders, and demanding due dates.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain independence, collaborate across functions and constructively resolve differences.
* Excellent command of English and Chinese and outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all organizational levels. Additional language skills are appreciated.
* Strong SAP S/4HANA skills. Experience with Ariba, Concur, Power BI, Tableau or comparable solutions is preferred, together with the ability to perform practical data analysis and analytics.
* Experience with eDiscovery, electronically stored information and digital evidence review.
* Big Four or comparable forensic advisory experience is a plus.
* Willingness to travel internationally up to 10%.
* High degree of integrity, discretion, resilience, cultural awareness and commitment to fair, objective and well-documented investigations.

title: Content Researcher
description:
**Content Researcher**

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Experience:**
Prior experience in content research, writing or a related field preferred, but not mandatory

**Type:**
Full-time

**Read This Before You Apply**

At ARL, we value curiosity, initiative, clear thinking and the ability to turn research into useful content.

We're looking for someone who pays attention to what is happening in the market, asks thoughtful questions, spots patterns and understands what an audience needs to know. You should enjoy going beyond surface-level trends to understand why a topic matters — and then turn those insights into clear, engaging written content.

Prior experience as a content researcher is a plus, but it isn't a requirement. We care more about your research instincts, analytical ability, writing, and willingness to learn.

**Who We Are & Why ARL**

At AgResearch Labs (ARL), we're building technology and infrastructure for cleaner, more climate-resilient food production.

Over more than a decade of R&D, ARL has developed indigenous aeroponics and farm-automation technologies that power Growize Farms, our commercial platform for building and operating high-performance farms at scale.

Recognised among India's Top 100 deep-tech startups by NASSCOM, ARL is entering its next phase of growth — scaling our business, teams and operating systems.

This creates an opportunity to help shape how we explain our work, engage our audiences and contribute to conversations around agriculture, food production, technology and the markets we operate in.

**The Role**

As a Content Researcher, you will identify relevant topics, investigate what audiences and markets care about, and turn your findings into thoughtful, well-written content.

You'll explore market needs, industry developments, audience questions, emerging conversations and content trends to understand what is worth saying, who it is for and how best to communicate it.

The role is not limited to writing from a brief. We want someone who can help identify the brief in the first place: someone who can research independently, connect ideas, analyse what works across different channels and develop content that is useful, relevant and engaging.

**What You'll Own**

**Market, Audience & Topic Research**

* Stay curious about developments in the market, industry news, customer needs, audience conversations and emerging trends relevant to ARL.
* Research topics using credible sources, reports, articles, interviews, social platforms, search trends and other relevant inputs.
* Identify the questions, challenges, misconceptions and interests that matter to our audiences.
* Separate meaningful signals from passing trends, and explain why a topic is relevant to ARL and its audience.
* Build a pipeline of researched topics, angles and content opportunities.

**Content Ideation & Writing**

* Turn research and insights into clear, engaging written content across formats such as educational explainers, articles, thought pieces, anecdotes, social posts, newsletters and website content.
* Develop strong angles, hooks and narratives rather than simply summarising information.
* Adapt the depth, tone, structure and format of content to the intended audience and channel.
* Translate technical or complex ideas into accessible content without losing accuracy or nuance.
* Work with internal subject-matter experts to validate information and uncover useful stories, examples and perspectives.

**Content Analysis & Performance Learning**

* Study content from relevant brands, creators, publications and competitors to understand what earns attention, builds trust and drives engagement.
* Analyse available performance signals — such as reach, engagement, saves, shares, clicks, search visibility or reader feedback — to understand what is working and why.
* Use evidence and audience response to refine topics, formats, distribution choices and future content ideas.
* Develop hypotheses, test different angles and document learnings rather than relying only on intuition.
* Understand that different channels and audiences need different approaches; content that works in one place may not work in another.

**Research Quality & Collaboration**

* Verify facts, check sources and maintain a clear distinction between evidence, interpretation and opinion.
* Keep research organised, with source links, key findings and useful context that others can review.
* Collaborate with the marketing, business and technical teams to align content with business priorities and audience needs.
* Manage multiple topics and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and writing quality.
* Use AI and research tools thoughtfully to improve efficiency, while independently verifying claims and adding original judgment.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong curiosity about markets, people, industries and why certain ideas or stories resonate.
* Good research and analytical instincts — the ability to find credible information, connect dots, spot patterns and draw useful conclusions.
* Clear, engaging writing with the ability to explain ideas simply and adapt to different formats.
* An understanding that effective content starts with audience needs and a clear purpose, not just a trending topic.
* The ability to assess what content works, for whom, on which platform and why — using both qualitative judgment and available data.
* Initiative to suggest topics and angles, ask questions and develop ideas without waiting for a fully defined brief.
* Attention to detail, factual accuracy and a willingness to revise work based on feedback and evidence.
* Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where content priorities and business needs can evolve.

Prior experience as a content researcher, content writer, journalist, editorial researcher, market researcher or in a related role is good to have, but not mandatory. Strong writing samples, research projects, personal publications or other evidence of your ability to think and communicate well are welcome.

**Good to have:**
Experience with digital content, SEO, social media analytics, audience research, industry publications or content planning; familiarity with agriculture, food systems, sustainability, climate, technology or deep-tech topics; comfort using spreadsheets, analytics dashboards and AI-assisted research tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You consistently identify relevant topics and angles grounded in audience needs and market developments.
* Your content is accurate, clear, engaging and appropriate for its intended audience and channel.
* Research leads to useful insights and original angles, rather than surface-level summaries.
* Content ideas become a consistent pipeline of work that supports ARL's communication and business priorities.
* You learn from performance data and feedback, and use those learnings to improve future content.
* Internal teams can rely on your research, source quality and written output.

**Why This Role**

This is an opportunity to help shape how a growing deep-tech and AgTech business communicates with the world. You'll have room to explore ideas, understand an evolving market, learn from subject-matter experts and turn complex topics into content that informs, engages and builds understanding.

If you're curious about why people pay attention to certain ideas, enjoy getting to the bottom of a topic and can turn what you learn into compelling writing, we'd like to hear from you.
